[[Toriimo's Torch]] is a  [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] obtained from [[Grahame]] in [[Lion's Arch Keep]] after completion of [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]] in exchange for 10 [[Medal of Honor|Medals of Honor]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Fire damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Energy Storage]])
:Halves skill recharge of spells (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of spells (Chance: 10%) 
:[[Energy]] +5 
:[[Enchantments]] last 20% longer

==Skin==
It has the same skin as the [[Embercrest Staff]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create a technical replica (excluding type of damage, as all listed staffs deal [[chaos damage]]) for this item with:
*One of the following [[Energy Storage]] [[staves]]:
**[[Ether Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Elemental Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]].
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Enchanting]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Don't Think Twice]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Eldritch Staff]] has nearly identical stats to this item; however, it requires [[Divine Favor]].

==Notes==
* Although this staff shares [[High Inquisitor Toriimo]]'s name, the [[warrior]] [[boss]] is never seen using a staff. However, he is infamous among Krytans for his use of fire ''"as a tool of interrogation and intimidation"'' and uses a few fire-based skills.
